en: The front of the postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a lush outdoor palm garden, with many palm trees and well-manicured flower beds, set along a walking path with benches and planters. At the bottom of the image is the text 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Palmengarten.' The reverse side of the postcard has handwritten text in German script, a stamp box marked 'Cekade 32,' a museum stamp, the word 'Kupfertiefdruck', and is marked 'Cramers Kunstanstalt, Dortmund. Py.t. 215.'
